_icon_info: The 'symbol' field accepts any free Font Awesome 6 solid icon name (use the icon name without prefix or extension).
The plugin uses FA 6.7.2 as bundled with Moodle's Boost theme.
_visibility_roles_info: The 'visibility_roles' field accepts an array of numeric Moodle role IDs.
An empty array [] means the item is visible to all roles.
Role IDs are site-specific. Find them at: Site administration > Users > Permissions > Define roles (/admin/roles/manage.php).
Typical default role IDs (exact IDs may differ on your instance):
1 = Manager,  2 = Course creator,  3 = Teacher (editing),  4 = Non-editing teacher,
_multilang_info: All text fields support multilang filtering:
name: {mlang en}English name{mlang}{mlang de}Name auf Deutsch{mlang}
description: {mlang en}English description{mlang}{mlang de}Beschreibung auf Deutsch{mlang}
